messages.content:
Reword the question so that it asks exactly the same thing in different words and a different sentence
structure. Keep every name, model, position number, article number, date and condition exactly. Do not add or
remove any detail. Return only the reworded question.

According to the UNIVPM equipment guideline, the written results of the checks on work equipment (such as the machines of the cell) must be kept available to the supervisory bodies for at least how long back?

response.text: Per the UNIVPM equipment guideline, for how far back in time must the written results of the checks carried out on work equipment (for example, the cell's machines) be kept available to the supervisory bodies, at minimum?
